story: Sophie is playing in the garden. [emotion:QT/surprised] Sophie sees a tiny fairy sitting on a red flower. The fairy has small, sparkly wings. The fairy is holding a little wand. Sophie picks three big leaves. Sophie puts the leaves in a circle on the ground. The fairy sits in the middle of the circle. Then the fairy waves the wand. [emotion:QT/surprised] Suddenly, the red flower turns bright yellow! [gesture:clapping] Sophie and the fairy clap their hands together. The fairy smiles at Sophie. [emotion:QT/happy]
